caption: The drawing depicts a square composition with a large, central, multicolored eight-pointed star composed of small, zigzagging geometric segments in shades of pink, red, orange, yellow, green, and purple radiating outward from the center. This star occupies most of the interior space and is bordered by a wide band. Surrounding the star are four triangular corner panels, each adorned with intricate botanical designs that include stylized flowers, leaves, and paisley-like motifs primarily in pastel blue, green, and pink tones, along with some gold and red highlights. The outermost border is a wider band, decorated with a vine running around the perimeter, bearing multicolored flowers and leaves, and punctuated with rounded red and pink forms. A thin red scalloped line runs along the inside edge of the outer border, framing the central design. The overall artwork is set against an off-white or light beige background.
title: Applique and Patchwork Coverlet - Star of Bethelehem
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
